en.b2bTitle: From Buyer Registration to Export Compliance
en.b2bCopy: Register as a buyer, submit the required documents, and track your export journey from proforma preparation to customs clearance.
en.guestProformaCopy: Select products and calculate carton, pallet, kilogram, and order totals without creating an account.
en.b2bStepOneCopy: Company identity, tax registration, authorization and destination market checks are completed before the file is opened.
en.b2bStepTwoCopy: Products are matched with HS codes, certificates, restrictions and country-specific import requirements.
en.b2bStepThreeCopy: Incoterm, currency, payment term, pallet plan, loading weight and delivery responsibility are clarified.
en.b2bStepFourCopy: Invoice, packing list, transport document, origin certificate and compliance documents are prepared in order.
en.proformaOrderCopy: Open the product selector, search by brand or product name, enter carton quantities and add items to the proforma total.
en.customsCopy: Plan the export file from buyer verification to customs declaration, origin documents and transport paperwork.
en.customsCoreDocsCopy: Keep the commercial, origin, product and transport files together before loading.
en.customsDocOrigin: Certificate of origin, A.TR / EUR.1 when applicable
en.customsDocTransport: CMR, bill of lading or airwaybill
en.logisticsCenterTitle: Border gates, ports, and air cargo tracking center
en.logisticsCenterCopy: Track logistics through live official sources in a focused workspace.
en.contactCopy: The form prepares an email draft for your request. You can also reach us directly through Telegram or email.
en.introTitle: Sidya Global connects reliable supply with the right markets.
en.introCopy: Sidya Global is a Trabzon, Türkiye based export-focused trading platform connecting manufacturers and brand partners with international buyers.
en.missionCopy: To help buyers reach the right products, reliable suppliers and transparent export processes quickly.
en.visionCopy: To make Türkiye-based products strong, sustainable and preferred brands in regional and global markets.
en.gtipCopy: Search a product name to see the likely HS/GTIP family, required document notes and official verification step.
en.gtipSeoCopy: GTIP is Türkiye's 12-digit customs tariff statistical position code. The first 6 digits follow the international HS system; the final classification must be checked with product composition, use, packaging and official tariff sources.
en.customsPlannerCopy: Select the destination, transport type and Incoterm to see the operational customs file.
en.customsStatusCopy: Commercial documents, origin documents and shipment instructions should be checked before declaration.

tr.introTitle: Sidya Global, güvenilir tedarik ile doğru pazarları buluşturur.
tr.introCopy: Sidya Global, Trabzon merkezli; üretici ve marka iş ortaklarını uluslararası alıcılarla buluşturan ihracat odaklı bir ticaret platformudur.
tr.missionCopy: Alıcıların doğru ürüne, güvenilir tedarikçiye ve şeffaf ihracat süreçlerine hızlı ulaşmasını sağlamak.
tr.visionCopy: Türkiye merkezli ürünleri bölgesel ve küresel pazarlarda güçlü, sürdürülebilir ve tercih edilen markalar haline getirmek.
tr.gtipCopy: Ürün adını arayarak olası HS/GTIP ailesini, gerekli evrak notlarını ve resmi doğrulama adımını görün.
tr.gtipSeoCopy: GTIP, Türkiye’nin 12 haneli gümrük tarife istatistik pozisyon kodudur. İlk 6 hane uluslararası HS sistemini izler; nihai sınıflandırma ürün bileşimi, kullanım amacı, ambalaj ve resmi tarife kaynaklarıyla kontrol edilmelidir.

tr.customsStatusCopy: Beyan öncesinde ticari evraklar, menşe belgeleri ve sevkiyat talimatları kontrol edilmelidir.

az.customsPlannerCopy: Operativ gömrük faylını görmək üçün təyinat bazarı, nəqliyyat tipi və Incoterm seçin.
az.customsStatusCopy: Bəyannamədən əvvəl kommersiya sənədləri, mənşə sənədləri və göndəriş təlimatları yoxlanmalıdır.

ru.heroTitle: Доступ к надежным товарам из Турции

ru.contactTitle: Быстро отправьте ваш запрос на покупку.
ru.introTitle: Sidya Global соединяет надежные поставки с правильными рынками.
ru.introCopy: Sidya Global — экспортно-ориентированная торговая платформа из Трабзона, соединяющая производителей и бренды с международными покупателями.

ru.gtipCopy: Введите название продукта, чтобы увидеть вероятную группу HS/GTIP, примечания по документам и шаг официальной проверки.

ru.customsPlannerCopy: Выберите рынок назначения, тип транспорта и Incoterm, чтобы увидеть операционный таможенный файл.
ru.customsStatusCopy: Перед декларацией необходимо проверить коммерческие документы, документы происхождения и инструкции по отгрузке.
